text: Review of the fixes: APPROVE at 5858ad1 (M1 reproducer refused; the M2/M3 check-removal mutants and a reviewer mutant dropping the QueryCount guard all killed). Remaining lows, follow-ups not blockers: (1) the count check can't catch a layout that swaps two participants with equal query counts inside one cell; the complete fix compares key sets by the report's own participant labels, and the docs currently require the evaluation layout. (2) NoRecord's message prints the raw MissingSource (ResultNavigation.scala:73) because MissingSource has no message method; cosmetic, the diagnostic operand is structured. G3 lands after CR6a with one main merge and a full gate.
